name: AutoSet SL TP
summary: AutoSet SL TP is a utility EA that automatically sets Stop Loss and Take Profit levels for trades that are opened without them. It monitors open positions and applies predefined SL/TP values based on user configuration, ensuring no trade is left unprotected.
summary_zh: AutoSet SL TP是一个实用工具型EA，自动为没有设置止损和止盈的持仓添加止损止盈水平。它监控未平仓位并根据用户预设参数应用SL/TP值，确保没有交易缺乏保护。
strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略型EA，而是一个仓位管理工具。其核心功能是持续监控所有未平仓订单，检测缺少止损或止盈的仓位，并自动为这些仓位设置预设的SL和TP值。入场条件方面，该EA不产生交易信号，而是作为辅助工具在交易已经开仓后介入。出场条件方面，它通过设置SL/TP间接管理出场，但自身不执行平仓操作。仓位管理方面，它不涉及开仓手数的计算，仅对已有仓位的风险参数进行补全。资金管理方面，该EA通过确保每笔交易都有止损保护来间接实现资金管理，防止因遗漏止损而导致的无限亏损风险。整体设计思路偏向防御性，旨在弥补手动交易或其它EA交易时遗漏止损止盈的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but rather a position management utility. Its core function is to continuously monitor all open positions, detect those missing stop loss or take profit levels, and automatically apply predefined SL/TP values to them. Regarding entry conditions, the EA does not generate trading signals but acts as a supplementary tool after trades have already been opened. For exit conditions, it indirectly manages exits by setting SL/TP levels but does not execute closures itself. In terms of position sizing, it does not calculate lot sizes for new entries, only supplementing risk parameters for existing positions. For money management, the EA indirectly supports capital preservation by ensuring every trade has stop loss protection, preventing unlimited loss exposure from trades opened without SL. The overall design philosophy is defensive, aimed at mitigating the risk of trades left unprotected without proper stop loss and take profit levels.

parameters.name: ApplyToNewOrders
parameters.description: 是否对新开仓订单应用SL/TP

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: 指定EA魔数，0表示监控所有订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 monitors all orders

pros: 自动补全遗漏的止损止盈，有效防止无保护持仓风险
可作为其它EA或手动交易的补充工具，增强整体风控体系
设置简单，参数直观，用户无需复杂配置即可使用
pros_en: Automatically supplements missing SL/TP, effectively preventing risk from unprotected positions
Serves as a complementary tool for other EAs or manual trading, enhancing overall risk management
Simple setup with intuitive parameters, users can start using it without complex configuration
cons: 固定点数止损可能不适合所有市场波动环境，缺乏动态调整能力
不区分不同交易品种的波动特性，对所有品种应用相同SL/TP值
无法根据账户余额或仓位大小动态计算风险比例，风控灵活性不足
cons_en: Fixed pip-based SL/TP may not suit all market volatility conditions, lacking dynamic adjustment capability
Does not differentiate volatility characteristics of different instruments, applying same SL/TP to all symbols
Cannot dynamically calculate risk ratios based on account balance or position size, insufficient risk management flexibility
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈功能，根据市场波动自动调整SL/TP水平
支持按品种单独配置SL/TP参数，适应不同交易品种的波动特性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic SL/TP functionality to automatically adjust levels according to market volatility
Support per-symbol SL/TP configuration to accommodate volatility characteristics of different trading instruments

risk_points: 固定止损点数在极端行情下可能过大或过小，无法适配当前波动
若EA意外停止运行，新开仓的交易将缺少自动止损保护
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss pips may be too large or too small during extreme market conditions, unable to adapt to current volatility
If the EA unexpectedly stops running, newly opened trades will lack automatic stop loss protection

summary_en: AutoSet SL TP is a utility EA that automatically sets Stop Loss and Take Profit levels for trades that are opened without them. It monitors open positions and applies predefined SL/TP values based on user configuration, ensuring no trade is left unprotected.
